item.description: ## New Features - Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224) - Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292) - Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293) - Added codex queue --resume to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232) - Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365) - Added codex doctor --network-only for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606) ## Bug Fixes - Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227) - Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502) - Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503) - Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635) - Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788) - Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline /quit and /exit handling. (#57820) - Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839) ## Chores - Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832) - Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837) - Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. ## New Features - Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with model_provider = "gcp". (#56265) - Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337) - Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308) - Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351) - Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163) - Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414) ## Bug Fixes - Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090) - Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091) - Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132) - Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330) - Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445) - Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. ## New Features - Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered /presets slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381) - Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline /model and /permissions arguments. (#54378, #54383) - Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216) - Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001) - Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers.
